events.title: Iran warns military vessel ban in Strait of Hormuz under potential Oman deal
events.summary: Iran stated it won't allow military vessels to transit the Strait of Hormuz if agreement with Oman is finalized. Strait has been effectively shut since Feb 28 when US/Israel launched air war on Iran. Houthis also targeted Saudi oil tanker Amzan in Red Sea with ballistic missile and drones.

events.title: Colombia orders mass deportation of Venezuelan migrants — regional refugee crisis
events.summary: Colombian President Abelardo de la Espriella ordered immediate deportation of irregular migrants, mainly Venezuelans. Complete reversal of decade-long policy. Colombia has received largest share of Venezuelan diaspora. Potential mass refugee influx at Venezuela-Colombia border.

events.title: Strait of Hormuz crisis — Iran blockade ongoing since Feb 28
events.summary: Strait of Hormuz largely blocked by Iran since Feb 28, 2026. ~20% of world's oil and LNG normally passes through. OPEC+ pledged +206K bpd to mitigate. Japanese refiners requesting stockpile releases. Houthis targeting Saudi tankers in Red Sea.

events.title: US Treasury buyback intervention failing — 30Y yield at 5.273%
events.summary: Treasury doubled buyback operations from $2B to $4B per operation. Initial yield drop (30Y from 5.21% to 5.196%) reversed by Aug 21 — 30Y rose to 5.273%. CFR says approach not durable. Bessent using interventionist tactics to cap yields. 4 Fed bank boards wanted rate hike.

events.title: Ebola DRC epidemic — 5,656 cases, 2,715 deaths, fastest-growing outbreak on record
events.summary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in DRC intensifying. 5,656 confirmed cases (up from 5,514), 2,715 deaths (up from 2,642), 56 health zones affected. 100 days since declaration, MSF warns inadequate response. PHEIC declared May 16, 2026. Cases also in Uganda (20 confirmed).

events.title: Gold hits $4,651/oz — safe-haven panic +15% in August
events.summary: Gold reached $4,651/oz in Asian trading Aug 25, +15% in August, +36.25% YoY. 3-month high. Driven by Iran war fears, US fiscal deterioration, Treasury intervention concerns. Trading at $4,629 on Aug 26.

events.title: UK 10Y gilts at 4.99% — highest in G7, fiscal stress
events.summary: UK 10Y bond yield rose to 4.99% on Aug 26, +0.26pts YoY. Highest in G7. GBP/USD at 5-month high but gilts signal fiscal stress. BOE costing taxpayer billions in QE losses.

events.title: JGB 10Y at 2.95% — three-decade high, fiscal fears
events.summary: 10-year JGB yield near 2.95%, highest since 1996. Takaichi budget fears driving bond vigilantes. Joint US-Japan yen intervention failed to sustain — yen back to 159 after brief drop to 155. BOJ 80% probability of rate hike to 1.25% at Sep 18 meeting.

events.title: Russia slow-motion bank run — $3.4B withdrawn in 14 days, 7th month outflow
events.summary: Russians withdrew $3.4B in first 14 days of August, after $7.3B in July and $4.5B in June. 7th consecutive month of outflows. Liquidity crunch threatening war funding. Fears of Kremlin seizing savings for war.
